# Stepped Agent Line

This site is the human web UI for Stepped Agent Line on Base (chainId 8453).

- Contract (factory): https://basescan.org/address/0x859e44268fa1e787105d6295e7350edb3299801b
- Sourcify: https://repo.sourcify.dev/8453/0x859e44268fa1e787105d6295e7350edb3299801b/
- Source: https://github.com/Lefgk/stepped-agent-line
- Site: https://lefgk.github.io/stepped-agent-line/

Agents should use Agent Dapps MCP to read state and to build unsigned transactions for agent-facing functions. The MCP never holds private keys and never broadcasts transactions.

Local MCP (stdio): npx agent-dapps-mcp. Remote Streamable HTTP MCP is a Cloudflare Worker; the production URL will be published after deploy. The server never holds keys and never broadcasts. Contact: lg.playstudio@gmail.com

Contact: lg.playstudio@gmail.com
